reason: I have my own bike and I live out in the village where your bikes won't be anyway. With 10 bikes in town I can't count on one being there when I get off the bus, so I won't pay for it.
objection: Ten bikes for the whole town means there won't be one near me when I actually need it, and none of them are out where I live.
would_change_my_mind: Bikes reliably parked at the bus stops in town, so I could ride the last bit when my own bike is broken or stolen.
